prose: The great Dylan Saccoccio launched his newest book today, The Real Universal Empire, and he's back on Vibe Rant to talk about the research within it! Cutting through the farrago of history and myth, T.R.U.E. explores artifacts, architecture, and language, to bring our understanding closer to reality when it comes to the origins and bones of our global civilization. By rectifying European history and better understanding our ancestors, what can we learn about ourselves?
